title: AgentActionGuardPolicy
description: Schema definition for agent action guard policies, tool permissions, and protected paths.

default_mode.description: Default operational mode for the assistant.

allowed_read_tools.description: List of safe inspection tools permitted during consultation mode.

blocked_mutating_tools.description: List of mutating tools blocked until explicit human approval.

protected_file_patterns.description: Glob patterns for confidential files that must never be modified.

prohibited_shell_commands.description: Blacklisted shell commands that risk system destruction or backdoor file edits.

confirmation_keywords.description: Human action command phrases required to unlock execution mode.
